references.note: third-party BGA wiki card page; re-checked 2026-11-24 (page rev. 2024/10/10). Confirmed: no cost (コスト: ー), no prerequisite (条件 blank), points none (勝利点: ー), effect = 'このカードには石だけを植えられる。このカードは畑1であるが、畑3であるかのように石材を植えられる。このカードの石は野菜のように種まきし、収穫する。' (only stone can be planted; considered 1 field but stone may be planted as if 3 fields; stone is sown and harvested as vegetables).

English list page row re-checked 2026-11-24 (list rev. 2026/06/12). Confirmed effect text: 'You can only plant stone on this card. Plant as though it were 3 fields, but it is considered 1 field. Sow and harvest stone on this card as you would vegetables.'

effects.notes: This card is a field. Only stone can be planted on it; it behaves as 3 fields for planting/harvesting but counts as 1 field; stone is sown and harvested as vegetables.

unresolved_fields: effects: card-as-field modeling ('this card is a field') is not covered by the effect vocabulary (R-C1). Re-checked 2026-11-24: JA p=2673 + EN list confirm 'このカードは畑1である / considered 1 field', '石だけを植えられる / only plant stone', and '畑3であるかのように石材を植えられる / plant as though it were 3 fields'; counts_as_fields=1, plants_as_fields=3, sown_like/harvested_like=vegetable are source-confirmed, but how the engine represents a card-field that counts as 1 field yet sows as 3 remains an engine-design question.
